day_phrase: the day appointed in this person's state (the states vote between Friday, 30 October and Wednesday, 2 December)

descriptors.R: nominee of the opposition party formed in the 1830s against the administration; a retired general and former officeholder in the Northwest, running on the hard times since the panic of 1837
descriptors.D: the sitting President, nominee of the party that has held the presidency since 1829, standing on the independent treasury and strict construction of federal power

compile_desc.R: the opposition party formed in the 1830s against the administration
compile_desc.D: the party that has held the presidency since 1829

others_line: Other candidates on some ballots, including the nominee of a small new antislavery party (answer "other").
never_name: Harrison, Tyler, Van Buren, Richard Johnson, Birney, Clay, Webster, Jackson or Calhoun

slice_sources.men: 1840 census (Sixth Census), free white men aged 20 and over (its nearest bracket to 21+) outside the eleven later-Confederate states; property and taxpaying tests had largely gone (Rhode Island kept a freehold test) and a few New England states let free Black men vote; calibrated to certified returns.
slice_sources.women: No women could vote for president in 1840; the 1840 census count of women aged 20 and over is shown for population only.
slice_sources.south-white: 1840 census, free white adults (20+) in the eleven later-Confederate states; white men voted, except that South Carolina's legislature chose its electors; calibrated to certified returns.
slice_sources.black-south: 1840 census, Black adults in the eleven later-Confederate states, overwhelmingly enslaved; enslaved people could not vote, and every Southern state had barred free Black men from voting by 1840 (Tennessee 1834, North Carolina 1835).
slice_sources.immigrants: Estimate only: the census did not record nativity before 1850, so the foreign-born count is back-projected from the 1850 census and arrival records; naturalized immigrant men (five years' residence) could vote, aliens could not.
